Stop for safety or resource limit. One justified transient retry OR separately logged diagnostic repeat, not both.

workflow_enumeration_limits: README and named downloader inspected; project also offers manually downloadable processed results and transformation scripts, not separate implemented external acquisition workflows. Full tree and hidden undocumented paths not exhaustively audited.

selected_task.scope: Full documented script default 1996–2024, source 2552-96 for years <=2011 and 2552-10 for years >=2010. Both versions requested in 2010 and 2011.

source.release: Script requests year-specific URLs; actual publisher revision and retrieval window require prospective lock before attempt.

runtime: Bash, wget, unzip, network and filesystem storage; script does not state account requirement. Output size, endpoint availability, terms and safety/resource fit unknown. Full downstream processing additionally requires R and related dependencies.
risks: No repository code run. Default full range may exceed resource limits; do not shorten after outcome. Script removes archives and uses HTTP; first assess safe acquisition and retention. No completed source-access, license, storage or independent-reference check.
configuration: The decision on conditional source pinning is a global human protocol decision, pending; no per-case exception is granted.
